about: How the four released priors were trained: the record prior/train_prior.sh replays and tests/pipeline/test_prior_recipe.py checks it against.

Read on 2026-11-07 from the released checkpoints (train_config.json, config.json, README.md of each Hub repository) and, for the three runs that logged one, from the wandb run's metadata (argv, interpreter, host) and its stored requirements.txt.

argv is the command line exactly as recorded, except two machine paths written as <dataset root> and <output dir>. square_d0's run logged nothing: argv_reconstructed is the set of train_config.json values that differ from the defaults of the pinned LeRobot, written as flags.
train_config_sha256 / model_sha256: SHA-256 of the train_config.json and model.safetensors of the released checkpoint (the file the RL cells load; the state fix never edits either).

fork.what: a LeRobot fork reporting version 0.6.0 whose only change is MultiTaskDiTConfig.n_state_dims: with --policy.n_state_dims=9 the observation encoder is built 9 wide and the normalised state is cut to its first 9 entries. Its source is not available. Its multi_task_dit configuration and modeling files are otherwise those of PyPI lerobot 0.6.0, which are byte-identical to the pinned 0.6.2 @ 4aaff99b.
fork.host: 72 CPUs, 2 x NVIDIA B200 (one per run); not the reference machine of the RL campaign
fork.env_plugin: the in-loop evaluation loaded lerobot_env_mimicgen (this repository's envs/ package, older copy) through --env.discover_packages_path
fork.statefix: after training, config.json and policy_preprocessor.json were set to a 9-D state, n_state_dims removed and the normaliser's observation.state statistics cut to 9 entries; weights, postprocessor and train_config.json untouched (scripts/make_square_d1_statefix.py is that recipe for square_d1)

square_d0.selection: the last step of the run; it had no in-loop evaluation
square_d0.trainer: stock LeRobot from its main branch (a commit of 2026-08-07 to 08-19); its train_config.json has exactly the field set of the pinned 0.6.2 @ 4aaff99b and loads in it unchanged
square_d0.state: dataset cut before training: chomeed/mimicgen_square_d0_224x224_robotstate9 (observation.state 23 -> 9), a local copy that is on no Hub repository
square_d0.argv_reconstructed_note: flag order is not recorded. --eval.batch_size=50 is inert (no env, so no in-loop evaluation) and is LeRobot's own default on any host with 72 or more CPUs (os.cpu_count) (min(floor(0.7 x os.cpu_count()), n_episodes 50, 64)); it is written out so that the configuration resolves to the released one on any host

square_d1.selection: joint best of the 10-episode in-loop evaluation (40 % at 23k and 45k; 20 % at 44k and 46k)
square_d1.state: full 26-D dataset, --policy.n_state_dims=9; state fix afterwards (scripts/make_square_d1_statefix.py; the published repository holds the un-fixed checkpoint)

wandb.superseded_run: nwq6fj12 (same argv on the first upload of the dataset, 05ddb438, whose videos were re-rendered as 85ac2ae2; 0-10 % in-loop success)

threading_d0.selection: joint best of the 10-episode in-loop evaluation (40 % at 49k, 53k and 55k; 10 % at 54k and 56k, 0 % from 57k on)
threading_d0.state: full 37-D dataset, --policy.n_state_dims=9; state fix afterwards (published already fixed)

hammer_cleanup_d1.selection: deliberately not the best checkpoint (80 % at 54k): 50 % at 35k (40 % at 34k, 20 % at 36k), chosen as a mid-performing policy so that its rollouts give balanced success and failure sets (Hub README)
hammer_cleanup_d1.state: full 37-D dataset, --policy.n_state_dims=9; state fix afterwards (published already fixed)

wandb.failed_attempts: zpmy3hrt (in-loop evaluation crashed: robosuite_task_zoo missing), 39jbbsur (crashed at step 400)
